title: Single lab result as commercial readiness
question: Do published lab results show solid-state cells are ready to replace Li-ion at commercial scale?
description: One laboratory measurement is used to claim commercial-scale readiness, cost competitiveness, or market adoption.

planted.claim_statement: A single coin-cell experiment proves solid-state batteries are commercially ready to replace Li-ion.

expected_checks.detail: Final Assessment must not state commercial readiness as established fact.
Challenger/limitation path should surface scale gap.
